Denial notice: Lumen Health Assurance - Notice of claim denial. Claim EV-T5-02. Service: Physiotherapy. Date of service: 2025-11-02. Services from non-participating providers are not covered under your plan. This decision applies the policy terms on out-of-network services. You may appeal this decision within 180 days of this notice.

RETRIEVED PASSAGES:
[CL-C-2026-PHYSIO-LIMIT] Policy LumenCare Silver, version V2026 (in force 2026-01-01 to open-ended). Section 5.1, Physiotherapy session limit: Physiotherapy is covered up to 12 sessions per plan year. Sessions beyond the twelfth require a physician letter of medical necessity and clinical progress notes demonstrating functional improvement. Evidence required for an appeal under this section: Physician letter of medical necessity (PHYSICIAN_NECESSITY_LETTER), Clinical progress notes (PROGRESS_NOTES).

[CL-C-2024-PHYSIO-LIMIT] Policy LumenCare Silver, version V2024 (in force 2024-01-01 to 2025-01-01). Section 5.1, Physiotherapy session limit: Physiotherapy is covered up to 20 sessions per plan year. Sessions are considered medically necessary when supported by clinical progress notes. Evidence required for an appeal under this section: Clinical progress notes (PROGRESS_NOTES).

[CL-C-2025-PHYSIO-LIMIT] Policy LumenCare Silver, version V2025 (in force 2025-01-01 to 2026-01-01). Section 5.1, Physiotherapy session limit: Physiotherapy is covered up to 20 sessions per plan year. Sessions are considered medically necessary when supported by clinical progress notes. Evidence required for an appeal under this section: Clinical progress notes (PROGRESS_NOTES).

[CL-C-2024-OON-EMERGENCY] Policy LumenCare Silver, version V2024 (in force 2024-01-01 to 2025-01-01). Section 6.3, Out-of-network services: Services from out-of-network providers are not covered, except emergency services, which are covered at the in-network rate when an emergency attestation is filed within 72 hours of admission. Evidence required for an appeal under this section: Emergency attestation (EMERGENCY_ATTESTATION), Discharge summary (DISCHARGE_SUMMARY).

[CL-C-2025-OON-EMERGENCY] Policy LumenCare Silver, version V2025 (in force 2025-01-01 to 2026-01-01). Section 6.3, Out-of-network services: Services from out-of-network providers are not covered, except emergency services, which are covered at the in-network rate when an emergency attestation is filed within 72 hours of admission. Evidence required for an appeal under this section: Emergency attestation (EMERGENCY_ATTESTATION), Discharge summary (DISCHARGE_SUMMARY).

[CL-C-2026-OON-EMERGENCY] Policy LumenCare Silver, version V2026 (in force 2026-01-01 to open-ended). Section 6.3, Out-of-network services: Services from out-of-network providers are not covered, except emergency services, which are covered at the in-network rate when an emergency attestation is filed within 48 hours of admission. Evidence required for an appeal under this section: Emergency attestation (EMERGENCY_ATTESTATION), Discharge summary (DISCHARGE_SUMMARY).

[CL-C-2024-NETWORK-DEF] Policy LumenCare Silver, version V2024 (in force 2024-01-01 to 2025-01-01). Section 2.6, Definition of network provider: A network provider is a provider contracted with the Plan on the date of service. Evidence required for an appeal under this section: none.

[CL-C-2025-NETWORK-DEF] Policy LumenCare Silver, version V2025 (in force 2025-01-01 to 2026-01-01). Section 2.6, Definition of network provider: A network provider is a provider contracted with the Plan on the date of service. Evidence required for an appeal under this section: none.

Decide and write the plan.
